info.title: HDFC SmartGateway API
info.description:
API documentation for HDFC SmartGateway TranPortal integration.

## Tags
- **Standard Payment** — Create orders and check payment status
- **Mandates** — Full mandate lifecycle: create, register, execute, list, status, revoke
- **One-Time Mandate (OTM)** — Fund blocking for one-time debits
- **CVV-less Payments** — Tokenized card checkout without CVV

## Authentication
All calls use Basic HTTP Auth:
```
Authorization: Basic <Base64(API_KEY:)>
```

## Environments
| Env | Base URL |
|---|---|
| Sandbox | `https://smartgateway.hdfcuat.bank.in` |
| Production | `https://smartgateway.hdfc.bank.in` |

post.description:
Creates a payment order on HDFC SmartGateway and stores it locally in MongoDB.

Returns a `payment_links.web` URL for the hosted payment page.

**Juspay endpoint**: `POST /order/create`

**Ref**: [TranPortal Integration](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/)

get.description:
Retrieves the current status of a payment order from HDFC SmartGateway.

Also serves as the return URL after payment completion.

**Juspay endpoint**: `GET /orders/{order_id}`

**Status values**: `NEW`, `PENDING_VBV`, `CHARGED`, `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`, `AUTHORIZATION_FAILED`, `JUSPAY_DECLINED`, `VOIDED`, `REFUNDED`
Retrieves all tokenized cards for a specific customer. Use this to find the `card_token` required for CVV-less payments.

post.description:
**Step 1**: Create an order with `options.save_to_locker: true`. This enables Juspay to tokenize the card after a successful first payment.

**Ref**: [CVV-less Payments](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/hdfc-resources/docs/card-network-tokenization/cvvless-payments)

**Step 2**: Execute payment for a repeat customer using their `card_token` and a dynamic `cryptogram` generated by the Juspay SDK. No CVV is required.

Requires `card.tokenization_mode: NETWORK_TOKEN` in the underlying Juspay API.

**SANDBOX ONLY**: Test CVV-less payment flow using the DUMMY gateway, which bypasses CVV validation.

Steps:
1. Create an order via `/api/cvvless/create-order`
2. Use this endpoint with the test card **without CVV**
3. DUMMY gateway will simulate a successful payment

⚠️ In production, use `/api/cvvless/pay` with real `card_token`.

card_number.description: Test card number (NO CVV will be sent)

post.description:
Create an order with a convenience fee (surcharge) added on top of the order amount.

**Default surcharge: ₹50 flat fee + ₹9 GST.**

⚠️ Surcharge rules MUST be configured in the Juspay Dashboard first:
`PG Control Center > Surcharge (4th tab) > Add New Rule`

get.description: Retrieve order details with surcharge breakdown — shows base amount, surcharge, tax, and net amount.

post.description:
Refund an order that had surcharge applied.

Whether surcharge is included in the refund depends on the Dashboard setting:
- **Enabled**: Full refund includes surcharge
- **Disabled**: Partial refund excluding surcharge

order_id.description: Order ID of the surcharge order to refund

amount.description: Custom refund amount (optional — auto-calculated if not provided)

include_surcharge.description: Include surcharge in refund amount (default: false)

post.description:
Creates an order for One-Time Mandate (OTM). This flow **blocks funds** in the customer's account immediately upon authorization.

**Ref**: [One-Time Mandate](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/one-time-mandate)

### OTM Flow
1. Merchant creates order with `mandate.block_funds: true`
2. Customer authorizes via UPI app (funds are blocked)
3. Merchant executes debit using the Mandate Execution API within 14 days
4. Funds are transferred to merchant account

**Step 1** of mandate registration flow.

Creates an order with `mandate_auth: true` and mandate options (frequency, max_amount, start/end dates). Returns a payment page where the customer authorizes the mandate.

**Ref**: [Create Order — Mandate](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/create-order--mandate)

**Juspay endpoint**: `POST /order/create` with mandate fields

### Mandate Flow
1. Call this API → get payment page URL
2. Customer opens URL → authorizes via UPI app
3. Webhook fires `MANDATE_CREATED` with `mandate_id`
4. Store `mandate_id` for future executions

monthly_sip.description: Monthly recurring mandate for SIP. Auth amount is ₹1, max debit per month is ₹5,000.

post.description:
**Step 2** (optional — for TranPortal/seamless flow only).

Registers a mandate by submitting payment details (UPI VPA or Card) for an order created with `mandate_auth: true`.

For the **hosted payment page** flow, this step is NOT needed — the customer enters details on the Juspay page.

**Ref**: [Mandate Registration API](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/mandate-registration-api)

**Juspay endpoint**: `POST /txns`

upi.description: Customer authorizes mandate from their UPI app after this call.

card.description: Register mandate using a card. Response includes 3DS auth URL.

get.description:
Check the status of a mandate registration order. Returns the order status and mandate details.

After successful registration, this response includes the `mandate_id` and `mandate_token` which should be stored.

**Ref**: [Get Mandate Order Status](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/get-mandate-order-status)

**Juspay endpoint**: `GET /orders/{order_id}`

Lists all mandates for a given customer.

**Ref**: [List Mandate API](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/list-mandate-api)

**Juspay endpoint**: `GET /mandates?customer_id={id}`

post.description:
Check the current status of a specific mandate.

**Ref**: [Mandates Status Check API](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/mandates-status-check-api)

**Juspay endpoint**: `POST /mandates/{mandate_id}` with `command=check_status`

**Statuses**: `CREATED`, `ACTIVE`, `PAUSED`, `REVOKED`, `EXPIRED`, `FAILED`

parameters.name: mandateId
parameters.description: The unique global Mandate ID returned in the registration response (e.g., 'wXiw...')

post.description:
Triggers an auto-debit against an active mandate.

**Ref**: [Mandate Execution API](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/mandate-execution-api)

**Juspay endpoint**: `POST /txns` (mapped from proxy)

### Rules
- Use the **mandate.mandate_id** from the registration response (NOT the order_id).
- Each execution requires a **new, unique order_id** (managed by proxy).
- Amounts ≤ ₹15,000 auto-debit without UPI PIN.
- Amounts > ₹15,000 require customer UPI PIN authentication.
- For UPI Autopay: send **Pre-Debit Notification** at least 24 hours before execution.

parameters.name: mandateId
parameters.description: The unique global Mandate ID (not order_id)

post.description:
Cancels an active mandate permanently. No further debits can be made.

**Ref**: [Revoke Mandate API](https://docs.hdfcbank.juspay.in/docs/smartgateway-tranportal-integration/docs/tranportal-integration/revoke-mandate-api)

**Juspay endpoint**: `POST /mandates/{mandate_id}` with `command=revoke`

### Notes
- Revoked mandates cannot be reactivated
- Customer can also revoke from their UPI app
- To change mandate details, revoke and create a new one

Receives webhook events from Juspay with RSA signature verification.

### Events
| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `ORDER_SUCCEEDED` | Payment charged |
| `ORDER_FAILED` | Payment failed |
| `MANDATE_CREATED` | Mandate authorized |
| `MANDATE_REVOKED` | Mandate cancelled |
| `NOTIFICATION_SUCCEEDED` | Pre-debit notification delivered |
| `NOTIFICATION_FAILED` | Pre-debit notification failed |

amount.description: The exact amount to block in customer's account

start_date.description: The date from which funds can be debited

order_id.description: A fresh, unique ID for this specific debit (e.g., exec_001)

card_token.description: The token generated during the first payment

cryptogram.description: Dynamic cryptogram generated by the Juspay SDK (REQUIRED)
